geography.text: Energy requirements is based on environmental report of Italian company. Total leakages are specific for CH, HD-leakages are calculated out of the total with German data.

technology.text: The quantity of gas delivered in the low pressure network is estimated. Households and half of commercial and of others are assumed to be connected to the low pressure network
